question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be added, and what redaction, permission, retention, export, and command-data boundaries must they follow?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the product and security boundary for exposing operational logs and command output in a new dashboard surface, especially while the dashboard substrate and binding model are still open.

options.title: Stage after substrate and security review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement the widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow to existing read-only data
options.body: Allow a focused implementation only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output events, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer bundled widgets
options.body: Keep this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage after substrate and security review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement the widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The dashboard proposal builds on the Control UI plugin-tab precedent authored and merged by steipete, making that the strongest product-direction routing signal.
